rubric.role_summary: Customer-facing sustainability data advisor working from the Mexico City office. Advises customers on carbon and non-carbon footprint measurement, emissions verification, and sustainability data and methodologies.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Customer-facing sustainability data advisor working from the Mexico City office. Advises customers on carbon and non-carbon footprint measurement, emissions verification, and sustainability data and methodologies.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 4+ years of experience in consulting, solutions engineering, or another customer-facing role.
- Experience in sustainability-related fields, greenhouse gas accounting and/or ESG reporting.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Mexico City, Mexico area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

soft_requirements: Customer-focused and analytically minded; excited to work directly with customers.
Excellent verbal and written communication, including explaining complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences.
Learns quickly, operates well in ambiguity, and is organized, systematic, and efficient in a high-volume environment.
Thinks clearly about complex problems; is comfortable using and speaking to data; and is meticulous and detail-oriented.
Passionate about addressing climate change and working at a fast-paced startup.
